what: Threshold-policy sweep for the long-ambiguous blind spot, scored through the SHIPPED plugin/gate_head.json artifact on probe families 1+2
verdict: No threshold policy recovers the blind spot: the score distributions overlap almost completely (long-ambiguous z in [-17.03, -4.19], long-executable z in [-24.72, -7.17]). At operational thresholds (>= 0.001) recall is 2/13 with zero false-asks; at 1e-5 recall is only 7/13 with 2/13 long-executable false-asks; at 1e-6 recall is 10/13 but false-asks 7/13. 10/13 long-ambiguous probes are deep-confidence misses (p < 1e-4). Mitigation must be upstream (training data / retraining), not a policy tweak on this head. The hook's blind_spot:true log flag stays heuristic-only.
reproducibility_note: Fresh machine + fresh deps (laya 0.4.30, onnxruntime 1.23.2) reproduce committed T5 val and every committed P2 per-probe score exactly; laya 0.4.26-0.4.30 embeddings are cos=1.0 identical.
